story.plot_summary: closeup of the speaking clan head with sound effects

story.narration_english: He would do even more than this for that alliance.

story.plot_summary: closeup of hand stroking the horse head

story.narration_english: Isn't it easier to cross a stream using two logs?

story.narration_english: Namgung might refuse both so that's why he called Gi here.

story.narration_english: He doesn't care what shady methods get used for this.

story.narration_english: Just make the whole damn alliance happen no matter what.

story.narration_english: Bro realizes all his techniques are nothing but cheap imitation.

story.narration_english: The absolute best way is learning directly under a real master.
story.narration_spanish: La mejor forma absoluta es aprender directamente de un maestro real.

story.narration_english: Becoming a disciple right away though is no easy task at all.

story.narration_english: Luckily the whole situation actually worked out pretty well for him.

story.narration_english: The assassin surges forward with swirling black energy trails.
story.narration_spanish: El asesino avanza con rastros de energía negra arremolinada.

story.narration_english: This pink-haired fighter freezes spotting that deadly technique.
story.narration_spanish: Este luchador de cabello rosa se congela al ver esa técnica mortal.

story.narration_english: Another brutal purple energy slash connects hard against the foe.
story.narration_spanish: Otro tajo de energía púrpura brutal conecta fuerte contra el enemigo.

story.narration_english: The final slash finishes the assassin in pure bloody chaos.
story.narration_spanish: El tajo final termina al asesino en puro caos sangriento.

story.narration_english: The assassin twists midair trapped in raging purple energy.
story.narration_spanish: El asesino se retuerce en el aire atrapado en energía púrpura furiosa.

story.narration_english: He confirms it really is the Ink Light Killing Sword.
story.narration_spanish: Confirma que realmente es la Espada Asesina de Luz de Tinta.

story.narration_english: The old master asks if ten years passed for Mad Cloud.
story.narration_spanish: El viejo maestro pregunta si pasaron diez años para Mad Cloud.

story.plot_summary: Static lower body shot of the old master standing armored

story.narration_english: Nine years and one hundred ninety days, the old dog answers.
story.narration_spanish: Nueve años y ciento noventa días, responde el viejo perro.

story.narration_english: Mad Cloud bursts into wild laughter at the sudden reunion.
story.narration_spanish: Mad Cloud estalla en una risa salvaje ante la reunión repentina.

story.narration_english: He notes the old dog remembers even the most trivial details.
story.narration_spanish: Nota que el viejo perro recuerda hasta los detalles más triviales.

story.narration_english: So what brings the Eighteenth Cloud all this way personally?
story.narration_spanish: Entonces, ¿qué trae a la Decimoctava Nube hasta aquí en persona?

story.narration_english: Orders have come down, Ash Shadow, and what are they?
story.narration_spanish: Han bajado órdenes, Ash Shadow, ¿y cuáles son?

story.plot_summary: Pure text bubble declaring the first stratagem

story.narration_english: Ash Shadow's face turns pure black with glowing white eyes.
story.narration_spanish: La cara de Ash Shadow se vuelve pura negra con ojos blancos brillantes.

story.narration_english: He leans back hard and grips the table edge tightly.
story.narration_spanish: Se reclina con fuerza y agarra el borde de la mesa con fuerza.

story.narration_english: We're finally doing it, good, what about Shifting Shadow?
story.narration_spanish: Finalmente lo estamos haciendo, bien, ¿qué hay de Shifting Shadow?

story.narration_english: The Namgung Clan wedding for Shifting Shadow is this month.
story.narration_spanish: La boda del Clan Namgung para Shifting Shadow es este mes.

story.narration_english: Wedding, Ash Shadow repeats in pure total disbelief right now.
story.narration_spanish: Boda, repite Ash Shadow con pura incredulidad total ahora mismo.

story.narration_english: His eye narrows hard as the full truth hits him.
story.narration_spanish: Su ojo se estrecha con fuerza cuando la verdad completa lo golpea.

story.narration_english: Don't tell me Shifting Shadow is the real target here.
story.narration_spanish: No me digas que Shifting Shadow es el verdadero objetivo aquí.

story.narration_english: His eye twitches hard as the real target hits him.
story.narration_spanish: Su ojo se crispa fuerte al impactarle el objetivo real.

story.plot_summary: pure text bubble asking then what is the full scope

story.narration_english: The white-haired elder stays silent processing the full plan.
story.narration_spanish: El anciano de cabello blanco se queda en silencio procesando el plan.

story.plot_summary: bloody clawed hand taps the table with Korean SFX and Asura watermark
text bubble stating everyone except Shifting Shadow and Namgung Hye

story.narration_english: He freezes hard after locking in that kill list.
story.narration_spanish: Él se congela fuerte tras fijar esa lista de muertes.

story.plot_summary: closeup of finger with blood droplet and Korean SFX

story.narration_english: The two shadows face off alone inside the quiet hall.
story.narration_spanish: Las dos sombras se enfrentan solas dentro del salón silencioso.

story.narration_english: He frets the Soul-Chasing Poison Hand arrives soon and forces aren't enough.
story.narration_spanish: Él se preocupa de que la Mano Venenosa llegue pronto y las fuerzas no basten.

story.narration_english: The old elder decides five shadows will handle this job.
story.narration_spanish: El viejo anciano decide que cinco sombras manejarán este trabajo.

story.plot_summary: bloody finger taps the table again with Korean SFX

story.narration_english: Really now he questions if five shadows is enough.
story.narration_spanish: ¿En serio ahora, él cuestiona si cinco sombras bastan.

story.narration_english: That should be enough against even the poison hand.
story.narration_spanish: Eso debería bastar incluso contra la mano venenosa.

story.narration_english: The elder confirms he has already delivered the orders.
story.narration_spanish: El anciano confirma que ya ha entregado las órdenes.

story.narration_english: By the way he starts probing for more details.
story.narration_spanish: Por cierto, él empieza a indagar por más detalles.

story.narration_english: What was Shifting Shadow's real name again he asks.
story.narration_spanish: ¿Cuál era el nombre real de Shifting Shadow otra vez pregunta.

story.narration_english: The old shadow stays dead silent under that question.
story.narration_spanish: La vieja sombra se queda en silencio total bajo esa pregunta.

story.narration_english: Then he just vanishes in a burst of black smoke.
story.narration_spanish: Luego simplemente se desvanece en una ráfaga de humo negro.

story.narration_english: Hah he's still as unlikeable as he ever was.
story.narration_spanish: Ja, todavía es tan desagradable como siempre lo fue.

story.narration_english: Ah man I'm so jealous of that lucky bastard.
story.narration_spanish: Ah hombre, estoy tan celoso de ese bastardo afortunado.

story.plot_summary: text monologue saying I thought shadows would live alone forever

story.narration_english: But Shifting Shadow became a hero of the orthodox faction.
story.narration_spanish: Pero Shifting Shadow se convirtió en un héroe de la facción ortodoxa.

story.narration_english: And he even got the first beauty of Anhui as bride.
story.narration_spanish: Y hasta consiguió a la primera belleza de Anhui como novia.

story.narration_english: While I'm just rotting away in this gloomy place.
story.narration_spanish: Mientras yo solo me pudro en este lugar sombrío.

story.narration_english: This old shadow heads to the balcony under moonlight.
story.narration_spanish: Este viejo sombra se dirige al balcón bajo la luz lunar.

story.narration_english: He snaps his fingers hard summoning a dark servant instantly.
story.narration_spanish: Él chasquea los dedos fuerte invocando a un sirviente oscuro al instante.

story.narration_english: A dark figure flees fast as he moves through the hall.
story.narration_spanish: Una figura oscura huye rápido mientras él avanza por el pasillo.

story.narration_english: He tells them to clean the room and ditch the bed filth.
story.narration_spanish: Les dice que limpien la habitación y se deshagan de la suciedad de la cama.

story.narration_english: And he still has one more ruthless order left for them.
story.narration_spanish: Y todavía tiene una orden más despiadada para ellos.

story.narration_english: Kill all the guards who were on duty today he orders.
story.narration_spanish: Maten a todos los guardias que estaban de servicio hoy, ordena.

story.narration_english: Yes the subordinate answers while slamming his fist hard.
story.narration_spanish: Sí, responde el subordinado mientras golpea su puño con fuerza.

story.narration_english: Branch leader he calls out with full respect in reply.
story.narration_spanish: Líder de la rama, llama con total respeto en respuesta.

story.narration_english: He gazes over the vast night city far below.
story.narration_spanish: Él mira sobre la vasta ciudad nocturna lejos abajo.

story.narration_spanish: El anciano se para solo mirando la ciudad nocturna brillante.

story.narration_english: This is the branch leader ready after those cold kills.

story.narration_english: Ash Shadow stays locked in with pure cold deadly focus.
story.narration_spanish: Ash Shadow se mantiene enfocado con puro enfoque frío y mortal.

story.narration_english: He knows the real chaos is about to kick off hard.
story.narration_spanish: Él sabe que el caos real está a punto de comenzar fuerte.

story.narration_english: Now it really begins he mutters with dark excitement.
story.narration_spanish: Ahora realmente comienza, murmura con emoción oscura.

story.narration_english: The full army marches under the glowing full moon.
story.narration_spanish: El ejército completo marcha bajo la luna llena brillante.

story.narration_english: Whoa whoa, the green master and girl halt now.
story.narration_spanish: Whoa whoa, el maestro verde y la chica se detienen.

story.narration_english: We arrived sooner than expected, the old dog notes.
story.narration_spanish: Llegamos antes de lo esperado, nota el viejo perro.

story.narration_english: Here is the place where Namgung clan reigns supreme.
story.narration_spanish: Aquí está el lugar donde el clan Namgung reina supremo.

story.narration_english: Lanterns float over the busy market full of laughs.
story.narration_spanish: Las linternas flotan sobre el mercado lleno de risas.

story.narration_english: The lion dance hypes up the whole festival street.
story.narration_spanish: La danza del león anima toda la calle del festival.

story.narration_english: Happy kids play under the grand lantern covered tower.
story.narration_spanish: Niños felices juegan bajo la gran torre de linternas.

story.narration_english: A guard points his staff straight at the beggars.
story.narration_spanish: Un guardia apunta su bastón directo a los mendigos.

story.narration_english: Please spare us a lump of rice to share.
story.narration_spanish: Por favor dennos un trozo de arroz para compartir.

story.narration_english: The guard's face twists hard in pure sudden rage.
story.narration_spanish: La cara del guardia se retuerce en pura rabia repentina.

story.narration_english: You beggar bastards, do you know where this is?
story.narration_spanish: Malditos mendigos, ¿saben en dónde están ahora mismo?

story.narration_english: Hah the guard kicks one beggar flying hard now.
story.narration_spanish: ¡Ja! el guardia patea a un mendigo volando duro.

story.narration_english: Brother the other beggars cry as they fall hard.
story.narration_spanish: ¡Hermano! los otros mendigos gritan mientras caen duro.

story.narration_english: What is this sudden commotion the older man asks.
story.narration_spanish: ¿Qué es este alboroto repentino? pregunta el hombre mayor.

story.narration_english: The young master walks out looking cool and sharp.
story.narration_spanish: El joven maestro sale luciendo cool y afilado.

story.narration_english: Young master it is nothing beggars just swarmed in.
story.narration_spanish: Joven maestro no es nada, solo mendigos invadieron.

story.narration_english: This young master stares down with a calm cool look.
story.narration_spanish: Este joven maestro mira con una mirada calmada y cool.

story.narration_english: Is that the banquet star Do Heo-ok they ask.
story.narration_spanish: ¿Es esa la estrella del banquete Do Heo-ok? preguntan.

story.narration_english: The young master steps out to check this sudden commotion.
story.narration_spanish: El joven maestro sale a verificar este alboroto repentino.

story.narration_english: He kindly asks if these beggars are alright right now.
story.narration_spanish: Él pregunta amablemente si estos mendigos están bien ahora.

story.narration_english: The beaten beggars can't believe this young master's kindness.
story.narration_spanish: Los mendigos golpeados no creen la amabilidad de este joven maestro.

story.narration_english: He helps the beggars while the guard just watches closely.
story.narration_spanish: Él ayuda a los mendigos mientras el guardia solo observa de cerca.

story.narration_english: Share leftover food with these people before the wedding starts.
story.narration_spanish: Comparte comida sobrante con esta gente antes de que empiece la boda.

story.narration_english: This rising star decides to feed the poor with leftovers.
story.narration_spanish: Esta estrella en ascenso decide alimentar a los pobres con sobras.

story.narration_english: The guards agree yes young master and he heads inside.
story.narration_spanish: Los guardias aceptan sí joven maestro y él entra adentro.

story.narration_english: Locals praise his character and why Namgung's daughter fell hard.
story.narration_spanish: Los locales alaban su carácter y por qué la hija de Namgung se enamoró.

story.narration_english: Who knew a young wanderer would become Namgung son-in-law?
story.narration_spanish: ¿Quién sabía que un joven vagabundo se convertiría en yerno de Namgung?

story.narration_english: One guy whispers about the Thunder Blade Emperor's lost arts.
story.narration_spanish: Un tipo susurra sobre las artes perdidas del Emperador de la Espada del Trueno.

story.narration_english: Hey watch where you are going one of them snaps.
story.narration_spanish: Oye mira por donde vas uno de ellos espeta.

story.narration_english: What? Soul-Chasing Poison Hand Tang Wu just appeared here.
story.narration_spanish: ¿Qué? La Mano de Veneno que Persigue Almas Tang Wu acaba de aparecer.

story.narration_english: This guy freezes in pure terror at the master's arrival.
story.narration_spanish: Este tipo se congela de puro terror ante la llegada del maestro.

story.narration_english: Tang Wu orders them to move since they're blocking the path.
story.narration_spanish: Tang Wu les ordena moverse ya que están bloqueando el camino.

story.narration_english: The old dog calls them useless bastards while walking right past.
story.narration_spanish: El viejo perro los llama bastardos inútiles mientras camina justo pasando.

story.narration_english: The young master greets the elders as the crowd gathers fast.
story.narration_spanish: El joven maestro saluda a los ancianos mientras la multitud se reúne rápido.

story.narration_english: He chats casually with an elder near the grand stairs.
story.narration_spanish: Él charla casualmente con un anciano cerca de las grandes escaleras.

story.narration_english: Silence the green master roars to shut the whole crowd.
story.narration_spanish: ¡Silencio! el maestro verde ruge para callar a toda la multitud.

story.narration_english: Are you saying I've come to a place I shouldn't?
story.narration_spanish: ¿Estás diciendo que he venido a un lugar que no debería?

story.narration_english: Say it to my face instead of whispering in the corner.
story.narration_spanish: Dilo a mi cara en vez de susurrar en la esquina.

story.narration_english: Someone begs Sir Tang to please calm down right now.
story.narration_spanish: Alguien ruega al Señor Tang que por favor se calme ahora.

story.narration_english: Greetings I am Do Heo-ok the young master declares politely.
story.narration_spanish: Saludos soy Do Heo-ok el joven maestro declara educadamente.

story.narration_english: So you are the young man who made me travel here.
story.narration_spanish: Así que tú eres el joven que me hizo viajar hasta aquí.

story.narration_english: Excellent excellent but that is all the old master states.
story.narration_spanish: Excelente excelente pero eso es todo el viejo maestro declara.

story.narration_english: The green master calls this young rising star quite disappointing.
story.narration_spanish: El maestro verde llama a esta joven estrella bastante decepcionante.

story.narration_english: He asks if Byeok is inside and the clan head waits.
story.narration_spanish: Pregunta si Byeok está adentro y el jefe del clan espera.

story.narration_english: The young master panics and offers to guide them inside fast.
story.narration_spanish: El joven maestro entra en pánico y ofrece guiarlos adentro rápido.

story.narration_english: They rush toward the grand hall as our boy watches from behind.
story.narration_spanish: Corren hacia el gran salón mientras nuestro chico observa desde atrás.

story.plot_summary: closeup top of black hair against dark hatching background

story.narration_english: Our psycho freezes with wide eyes sensing pure high level danger.
story.narration_spanish: Nuestro psico se congela con ojos abiertos sintiendo puro peligro de alto nivel.

story.plot_summary: title splash card for Murim Psychopath with bloody art and credits

story.narration_english: System warns an enemy over ten levels stronger just approached close.
story.narration_spanish: El sistema advierte que un enemigo más de diez niveles más fuerte se acercó.

story.narration_english: Bro stands in the street locking cold eyes on the new threat.
story.narration_spanish: Bro se para en la calle fijando ojos fríos en la nueva amenaza.

story.narration_english: He notes a subtle gap between this guy and Tang Wu.
story.narration_spanish: Nota una sutil brecha entre este tipo y Tang Wu.

story.narration_english: If so that means the new high level enemy is that guy.
story.narration_spanish: Si es así significa que el nuevo enemigo de alto nivel es ese tipo.

story.narration_english: Those glowing red eyes lock hard onto pure new prey.
story.narration_spanish: Esos ojos rojos brillantes se fijan fuerte en una nueva presa pura.

story.narration_english: Every human has left right asymmetry in face limbs and shoulders.
story.narration_spanish: Todo humano tiene asimetría izquierda derecha en cara extremidades y hombros.

story.narration_english: But that guy walking ahead is something totally different now.
story.narration_spanish: Pero ese tipo caminando adelante es algo totalmente diferente ahora.

story.narration_english: He is perfect. Too perfect for any normal human body.
story.narration_spanish: Él es perfecto. Demasiado perfecto para cualquier cuerpo humano normal.

story.narration_english: Red eyes flare realizing this perfect body is pure danger.
story.narration_spanish: Los ojos rojos se encienden al darse cuenta de que este cuerpo perfecto es puro peligro.

story.narration_english: He is of the same species hiding in a different form.
story.narration_spanish: Él es de la misma especie escondiéndose en una forma diferente.

story.narration_english: Another predator just walked right into our boy's hunting ground.
story.narration_spanish: Otro depredador acaba de caminar directo al terreno de caza de nuestro chico.

story.narration_english: They arrive at the massive Namgung Clan King's Hall fortress.
story.narration_spanish: Llegan a la masiva Fortaleza del Salón del Rey del Clan Namgung.

story.plot_summary: closeup of swords lined on the roof with debris

story.narration_english: The green master notes the swords of past clan heads above.
story.narration_spanish: El maestro verde nota las espadas de los jefes de clan pasados arriba.

story.narration_english: He mocks them calling themselves kings and looking down on people.
story.narration_spanish: Se burla de ellos llamándose reyes y mirando por encima a la gente.

story.narration_english: When they die they'll just sleep in a grave anyway.
story.narration_spanish: Cuando mueran solo dormirán en una tumba de todos modos.

story.narration_english: The young master offers to wait but the old dog refuses.
story.narration_spanish: El joven maestro ofrece esperar pero el viejo perro se niega.

story.narration_english: The green master stomps hard up those stairs right now.
story.narration_spanish: El maestro verde sube con fuerza esas escaleras ahora mismo.

story.narration_english: Didn't you say he's been waiting anyway, he snaps back.
story.narration_spanish: ¿No dijiste que ya estaba esperando, replica él de inmediato.

story.narration_english: Heavy doors slam open revealing the massive grand hall inside.
story.narration_spanish: Las pesadas puertas se abren revelando el enorme salón grandioso.

story.narration_english: Uncle she calls out spotting the clan head waiting there.
story.narration_spanish: ¡Tío! grita ella al ver al jefe del clan esperando.

story.narration_english: They step across the floor as the reunion fully begins.
story.narration_spanish: Avanzan por el piso mientras la reunión comienza por completo.

story.narration_english: The clan head welcomes his uncle after such a long time.
story.narration_spanish: El jefe del clan da la bienvenida a su tío tras tanto tiempo.

story.narration_english: Hmph look at this clan head running around without dignity.
story.narration_spanish: Hmph mira a este jefe de clan corriendo sin nada de dignidad.

story.narration_english: The green master just smirks with pure mocking amusement.
story.narration_spanish: El maestro verde solo sonríe con pura diversión burlona.

story.narration_english: Still good to see you after so long, you rascal.
story.narration_spanish: Aún es bueno verte después de tanto, sinvergüenza.

story.narration_english: Hwa stares in shock at how close the two elders are.
story.narration_spanish: Hwa mira con shock lo cercanos que son esos dos ancianos.

story.narration_english: Was grandfather and the clan head really that close she wonders.
story.narration_spanish: ¿Estaban el abuelo y el jefe tan cerca? se pregunta ella.

story.narration_english: Ah the girl turns around spotting Hwa standing right behind.
story.narration_spanish: Ah la chica se gira y ve a Hwa parada justo detrás.

story.narration_english: It's been a while Hwa she greets with a bright smile.
story.narration_spanish: Ha pasado un tiempo Hwa, la saluda con una gran sonrisa.

story.narration_english: Hwa compliments her beauty while she thanks her warmly back.
story.narration_spanish: Hwa elogia su belleza mientras ella le agradece con calidez.

story.narration_english: The young master watches quietly with a thoughtful calm expression.
story.narration_spanish: El joven maestro observa en silencio con expresión calmada y pensativa.

story.narration_english: Do Heo-ok introduces himself while Hwa asks to call him brother.
story.narration_spanish: Do Heo-ok se presenta y Hwa pide llamarlo cuñado de una.

story.narration_english: This girl now is, sister Hye frets getting totally flustered.
story.narration_spanish: Esta chica ahora es, la hermana Hye se pone totalmente nerviosa.

story.narration_english: He laughs accepting while Hwa teases about the marriage timing.
story.narration_spanish: Él ríe aceptando mientras Hwa bromea sobre el momento del matrimonio.

story.narration_english: Goodness this girl she facepalms in pure total embarrassment.
story.narration_spanish: Dios esta chica, se tapa la cara de pura vergüenza total.

story.narration_english: Her golden eye shows pure fluster from all that teasing.
story.narration_spanish: Su ojo dorado muestra pura incomodidad por todas esas burlas.

story.narration_english: Hwa by the way who is that person standing there she asks.
story.narration_spanish: Hwa por cierto, ¿quién es esa persona parada allí? pregunta ella.

story.narration_english: Our psycho stands as a dark silhouette in the bright light.
story.narration_spanish: Nuestro psico se para como silueta oscura en la luz brillante.

story.narration_english: Ah that person is they all turn to notice our psycho.
story.narration_spanish: Ah esa persona es, todos se giran a notar a nuestro psico.

story.narration_english: Our psycho finally drops his new Tang Sam name.
story.narration_spanish: Nuestro psico finalmente suelta su nuevo nombre Tang Sam.

story.narration_english: The girls freeze hard after hearing that bold intro.
story.narration_spanish: Las chicas se congelan fuerte tras oír esa intro audaz.

story.narration_english: The young master greets him with a bright friendly smile.
